from hermes_tools import write_file
p='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-hermes-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u097/system/state/workspace/programs/task-995f1084.py'
content='''def transform(grid):
    # extend the diagonal trace of color 8 in the direction indicated by the trace
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    bg=max(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda x:sum(r.count(x) for r in g))
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]
    eight=[(r,c) for r,c in pts if g[r][c]==8]
    if len(eight)>=2:
        # Find the most recent diagonal segment, extend its direction to bottom edge.
        a,b=sorted(eight)
        dr=b[0]-a[0]; dc=b[1]-a[1]
        if dr and abs(dc)==dr:
            r,c=eight[-1]
            while 0<=r+dr<len(g) and 0<=c+dc<len(g[0]):
                r+=dr; c+=dc
                if g[r][c]==bg: g[r][c]=8
                else: break
    return g
'''
print(write_file(p,content))
